title: Contrast Adjustment
text: 使用线性缩放调整图像对比度，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Adjust pixel values from} 指定输入像素值范围定义 Full input data range [min；{Range [low high]} 指定输入像素值范围、{Percentage of pixels to saturate [low high]} 指定要饱和的最大像素百分比、{Specify number of histogram bins (used to calculate the range when outliers are eliminated)} 指定自定义直方图 bin 数、{Number of histogram bins} 指定直方图 bin 数、{Adjust pixel values to} 输出像素值范围定义 Full data type、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 指定数据类型覆盖，按实例取值。

params.name: Adjust pixel values from
params.values: 输入像素值范围定义 Full input data range [min max] (default) | User-defined range | Range determined by saturating outlier pixels

params.name: Range [low high]
params.values: 输入像素值范围 [0 255] (default) | two-element vector of nonnegative numbers

params.name: Percentage of pixels to saturate [low high]
params.values: 要饱和的最大像素百分比 [1 1] (default) | two-element vector of nonnegative numbers

params.name: Specify number of histogram bins (used to calculate the range when outliers are eliminated)
params.values: 自定义直方图 bin 数 on (default) | off

params.name: Number of histogram bins
params.values: 直方图 bin 数 256 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Adjust pixel values to
params.values: 输出像素值范围定义 Full data type range (default) | User-defined range

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 数据类型覆盖 off (default) | on
